qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Strong domestic distribution and market share in Italian P&C and life, but returns on capital are structurally weak. 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 7.82% and tangible ROIC is <11%, failing Gate 3b return hurdles. Massive exposure to Italian sovereign debt (BTPs) creates systemic balance sheet correlation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Pricing Power & Proof of Moat, REJECT). Italian insurance leader severely fails the capital efficiency hurdle with a 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 7.82% and tangible ROIC of 9.3% in FY2025, well below the 12% GAAP and 15% tangible ROIC thresholds. Returns are diluted by legacy life guarantees and high sovereign debt concentration.
qualitative.evidence: FY2022-FY2025 GAAP ROIC remained stagnant between 5.28% and 8.55% (median 7.82%), with tangible ROIC failing to reach 11%. LT debt of €39.6B against net income of €4.2B yields net debt / NI of 7.73x, while extensive BTP holdings link capital solvency to Italian sovereign spreads.
